verdict.rationale: Unit is a financial infrastructure platform with a Dashboard and APIs that expose customer, account, and transaction data, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI-generated insights, suggestions, or analysis of that data. Data access alone is an adjacent building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
